message.content:
Answer: C
Reason: The serial chest X-rays demonstrate a progression from initial subtle reticular opacities to more extensive bilateral lung density (consolidation/ground-glass), followed by clearing, which is the characteristic radiographic evolution of COVID-19 pneumonia leading to recovery. Options suggesting persistent edema, bacterial consolidation without improvement, or chronic conditions do not fit the observed temporal pattern of worsening then resolving acute infiltrates.
